2. Assertion (A): Two moles of a given mass of a gas occupy a volume of 44.8 L
at STP.
Reason (R): Volume of a given mass of a gas depends on temperature and
pressure.
(a) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
(b) Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
(c) A is true and R is false.
(d) A is false and R is true.

3. Arrange the following in the decreasing order of number of oxygen atoms.
(A) 0.5 moles of sulphuric acid (B) 1 mole of water
(C) 0.25 moles of nitric acid (D) 2 moles of hydrogen peroxide
(E) 1 mole of ferric oxide
(a) DABEC (b) BAECD
(c) DEABC (d) BCDEA

4. Assertion (A): A balloon filled with air and tightly tied, when hung close to
the source of heat, bursts after some time.
Reason (R): The pressure exerted by the gas is inversely proportional to the
temperature of the gas.
(a) Both A and R are true and R is the correct explanation of A.
(b) Both A and R are true, but R is not the correct explanation of A.
(c) A is true and R is false.
(d) A is false and R is true.
